candidate_relations.label: Testicular cancer, bilateral
candidate_relations.reason: Testicular cancer, bilateral is a generic parent category that encompasses the correct organ and malignancy but lacks the required histologic specificity of spermatocytic seminoma (triomorphic small/medium/large cell pattern, normal tumor markers, older patient). The bilateral descriptor also conflicts slightly with the reference diagnosis derived from a unilateral orchiectomy specimen.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Broad parent category without specifying spermatocytic seminoma histology; bilateral scope noted but reference is unilateral specimen-based diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Classic spermatocytic seminoma presentation: older male, painless bilateral enlargement, normal tumor markers, triomorphic histology
Bilateral involvement noted clinically but reference diagnosis based on unilateral specimen
